description: Experience bottles thrown with two clicks a tick, then switching to a golden apple while still clicking, then holding to eat it; snowballs thrown by holding use; ender pearls straight up, held back by their cooldown, landing back on the player.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
